claims.RA1: Initial unreadability prevents hosts writes for both nonempty and empty routes and cleanup.
claims.RA2: Manual sync rereads after successful writes, and unreadable verification is failure even for empty routes.
claims.RA3: Empty routes remove stale managed entries while preserving unrelated hosts content.
claims.RA4: New read failures use the unchanged caller elevation/error path; no new retry loop or rollback is promised.
claims.RA5: Immediate retries are inspected after faults before, at, and after the write commit point. Preexisting partial-write and atomicity defects are not attributed to this PR.

safety: Only disposable fixture hosts I/O, fake getuid and sudo. No real hosts access, elevation, trust-store operation, proxy operation, user-state access, source fixes, or target git mutation. All artifacts only in the authorized resilience directory; parent manifest must not be edited.
contract_digest_scope: Provisional stage-local contract, not an invented digest for the unavailable parent manifest. Parent orchestration must reconcile acceptance IDs/digest before treating this as an integrated gate receipt.
